title: Inventory Operations
prompt: Implement `add_stock(map, item, qty)` (adds qty to item, inserting if needed) and `stock_of(map, item)` (returns qty, or 0 if absent — WITHOUT using operator[] on the read path).

tests.name: add new
tests.hint: Inserting a new item with its qty.

tests.name: add existing
tests.code: auto s = add_stock(add_stock({}, std::string{"pen"}, 10), std::string{"pen"}, 5); CHECK_EQ(s.at(std::string{"pen"}), 15);

tests.name: read missing
tests.hint: Missing item reads as 0 without inserting anything.
